Application Data.NAME: Smith's Locksmith Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith's Locksmith Services specializes in providing a full range of locksmith services, including residential, commercial, and automotive lock installations, repairs, and emergency lockout assistance. Our team is equipped with state-of-the-art tools and electronic programming devices to handle complex key systems and security solutions. We prioritize the security of our inventory and client information, adhering to strict procedures to prevent theft and unauthorized access. Additionally, we offer small group instructional courses for those interested in learning locksmithing skills, ensuring a controlled environment with no more than 10 students per session. Our commitment to safety and best practices in data management is paramount to our operations.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Inventory and Equipment Risks: Locksmith tools and electronic programming devices are
often expensive and portable, increasing theft risk. Premises security and inventory control
procedures are critical underwriting factors.
• Cyber Exposure: Locksmiths that maintain electronic records of client security codes or
use computerized key programming may face cyber liability risks if data is compromised.
